VAR 720009    NAME-PSU CODE
              COLUMNS 34   - 36
              NUMERIC
              NO MISSING DATA CODES

                 PRIMARY SAMPLING UNIT (PSU) OF INTERVIEW
                 ........................................

                 THE FIRST 2 DIGITS OF THIS VARIABLE IDENTIFY THE PRIMARY
                 SAMPLING UNIT.  THE NEW YORK CITY AND CHICAGO PSU'S ARE EX-
                 CEPTIONS IN THAT THEY ARE IDENTIFIED BY TWO OR MORE 2-DIGIT
                 CODES.  THE CHICAGO PSU IS IDENTIFIED BY CODES '10' AND
                 '11'; THE NEW YORK CITY PSU IS IDENTIFIED BY THE CODE RANGE
                 '20'-'24'.  IN ADDITION, THE FIRST DIGIT OF THE PSU IDEN-
                 TIFIES THE MAJOR GEOGRAPHIC REGION.

                                SELF-REPRESENTING     NON-SELF-REPRESENTING
                 REGION         PSU'S - 1ST DIGIT       PSU'S - 1ST DIGIT
                 ------         -----------------     ---------------------

                 WEST                  0                       8
                 NORTH CENTRAL         1                      6,7
                 NORTHEAST             2                       9
                 SOUTH                 3                     3,4,5

                 THE THIRD DIGIT OF THE PSU IS BASED ON THE POPULATION DENSITY
                 OR DEGREE OF URBANIZATION.

                 3RD DIGIT   DEGREE OF URBANIZATION
                 ---------   ----------------------

                    1,2      CENTRAL CITIES OF THE 12 LARGEST SMSA'S (SELF-
                               REPRESENTING PSU'S)
                    3,4      SUBURBS OF THE SELF-REPRESENTING PSU'S
                    5,6      NON-SELF-REPRESENTING PSU'S WHICH DO INCLUDE
                               A CENTRAL CITY OF A SMSA
                    7,8      NON-SELF-REPRESENTING PSU'S WHICH DO NOT INCLUDE
                               A CENTRAL CITY OF A SMSA

                 SEE APPENDIX NOTE

VAR 720011    NAME-SIZE OF INT PLACE-4 STEP
              COLUMNS 41   - 41
              NUMERIC
              NO MISSING DATA CODES

                 SIZE OF INTERVIEW PLACE - 4 STEP
                 ................................

           246       1.  CENTRAL CITIES OF THE 12 SELF-REPRESENTING PSU'S
           440       2.  SUBURBS OF THE 12 SELF-REPRESENTING PSU'S
          1057       3.  PLACES IN A NON-SELF-REPRESENTING, SMSA PSU
           962       4.  PLACES IN A NON-SELF-REPRESENTING, NON-SMSA PSU

                 THE 12 LARGEST METROPOLITAN AREAS OR PSU'S ARE COEXTENSIVE
                 WITH THE TWO STANDARD CONSOLIDATED AREAS PLUS THE 10 LARGEST
                 OF THE REMAINING STANDARD METROPOLITAN STATISTICAL AREAS
                 (SEE 1960 CENSUS OF POPULATION, VOL. 1).  THESE 12 PSU'S ARE
                 SOMETIMES REFERRED TO AS "SELF-REPRESENTING" BECAUSE EACH
                 PSU REPRESENTS ONLY ITSELF IN THE SRC'S NATIONAL SAMPLE OF
                 DWELLINGS.  THE REMAINING 62 PSU'S IN OUR SAMPLE ARE NON-
                 SELF-REPRESENTING BECAUSE EACH OF THEM REPRESENTS ITSELF AND
                 AT LEAST ONE OTHER PSU.

VAR 720306    NAME-R'S EMPLOYMENT STATUS
              COLUMNS 504  - 504
              NUMERIC
              NO MISSING DATA CODES

                 **FORMS 1 AND 2**                      PRE-ELECTION QUESTION

                 K6.  WE'D LIKE TO KNOW IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR WORK, RETIRED,
                      (A HOUSEWIFE), (A STUDENT), OR WHAT?
                 ............................................................

                 THE INTERVIEWER CHECKED Q.D22 OR Q.D30 (REF.NO.135) TO DETER-
                 MINE WHETHER OR NOT THE RESPONDENT WAS CURRENTLY WORKING. IF
                THE RESPONDENT WAS WORKING THE INTERVIEWER CODED 1 AND SKIPPED
                 TO Q.K7.  IF SUBSEQUENT QUESTIONING REVEALED THAT THE RE-
                 SPONDENT WOULD BE MORE APPROPRIATELY CODED IN A NON-EMPLOY-
                 MENT CATEGORY HE/SHE WAS CODED '2'-'8' BELOW.  FOR INSTANCE
                 A HOUSEWIFE WHO WORKED ONLY 10 HOURS/WEEK COULD BE CODED
                 '1' IN REF. NO. 135, BUT '7' IN THIS VARIABLE.  IF THE RE-
                 SPONDENT WAS NOT WORKING THE INTERVIEWER ASKED Q.K6.

          1496       1.  WORKING NOW
            22       2.  TEMPORARILY LAID OFF
            60       3.  LOOKING FOR WORK
            23       4.  UNEMPLOYED
           266       5.  RETIRED
            46       6.  PERMANENTLY DISABLED
           719       7.  HOUSEWIFE (INCLUDING HOUSEWIVES WHO WORK LESS THAN
                         20 HRS./WK.)
            73       8.  STUDENT (INCLUDING STUDENTS WHO WORK LESS THAN
                         20 HRS./WK.)

                CODING PROCEDURE: IF THE RESPONDENT IS RETIRED OR DISABLED BUT
                IS CURRENTLY WORKING IN A JOB RELATED TO HIS/HER PRIOR OCCUPA-
                 TION, HE/SHE IS CODED '1' IN THIS VARIABLE AND TREATED AS
                 "WORKING NOW" IN THE REST OF THE RESPONDENT'S OCCUPATION
                 SECTION VARIABLES; NO DATA ARE CODED FOR THE JOB PRIOR TO THE
                 CURRENT ONE.  IF THE RESPONDENT IS RETIRED OR DISABLED AND
                NOT WORKING OR CURRENTLY WORKING IN A JOB UNRELATED TO HIS/HER
                 PRIOR OCCUPATION, HE/SHE IS CODED '5' OR '6' IN THIS VARIABLE
                 AND TREATED AS "RETIRED" OR "DISABLED" IN THE REST OF THE
                 RESPONDENT'S OCCUPATION SECTION VARIABLES; DATA ARE GATHERED
                 FOR THE JOB PRIOR TO RETIREMENT OR DISABLEMENT.

                 OF THE FAMILY HEAD'S OCCUPATION SECTION VARIABLES; DATA ARE
